familiar.text: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

verses.restored: forty days, being tested by the adversarial one. He ate nothing in those days, and when they were completed, he was hungry.

familiar.text: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

verses.restored: The adversarial one said to him, If you are Son of the Divine, speak to this stone so that it may become bread.

familiar.text: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

verses.restored: Jesus answered him, It has been written: A human does not live by bread alone.

familiar.text: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

familiar.text: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
